text:
zhen: quick heads-up — customer-vpc-7 started showing p95->p99 latency spikes after yesterday's kernel-selector change. profiler shows lots of tiny batches + frequent KV cache evictions on 4xT4 smallgpu slices. link: https://internal/profiles/1979990000 :eyes:

sasha: ugh. do we know whether it's batching decision (batch formation window) or the kernel switch causing per-batch overhead?

zhen: digging. two signals: 1) batch sizes are ~1-4 tokens often (seq ~256, prefer_small_batch kernel chosen), 2) KV cache churn: evictions every ~12s when memory gets ~78% used. combined, kernel startup + memcpy overhead dominates. p99 increased from 220ms -> 420ms on these slices.

chris: can you paste the runtime knobs currently used in that VPC?

zhen: current effective config (private overrides):
```
vpc.batch_window_ms: 6
vpc.max_batch_tokens: 8192
vpc.token_budget_target: 4096
vpc.kv_evict_ratio: 0.35
runtime.kernel_hint: prefer_small_batch
runtime.kv_prefetch: false
```

ryan: interesting — token_budget_target is large relative to smallgpu memory. that might encourage forming big logical batches that then get sliced into tiny physical batches, forcing lots of kernel selection churn.

zhen: proposal: conservative canary that changes three things for customer-vpc-7: reduce token_budget_target, lower kv_evict_ratio, enable kv_prefetch so we avoid repeated on-demand loads. also bump batch_window_ms slightly to allow more coalescing on the small slice.

sasha: concrete numbers?

zhen: canary config patch (apply as per-tenant private override):
```
vpc.batch_window_ms: 12
vpc.max_batch_tokens: 4096
vpc.token_budget_target: 2048
vpc.kv_evict_ratio: 0.20
runtime.kernel_hint: prefer_fp16_matmul_if_available
runtime.kv_prefetch: true
```

chris: runtime.kernel_hint change might shift CPU->GPU memcpy patterns. prefer_fp16_matmul_if_available will avoid prefer_small_batch path if possible. agree to try.

ryan: test plan: 5% traffic canary for 1h, monitor p50/p95/p99, throughput, KV eviction rate, GPU mem pressure, and kernel switch rate (new metric). if p99 drops back near baseline and GPU OOMs are zero, promote gradually.

zhen: added profiling checklist in thread: collect contiguous 5m perf traces, kernel selection histogram, batch size histogram (tokens & requests), KV hit/evict counts, memcpy time breakdown.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: canary=customer-vpc-7, pct=5%, config-blob=/deploys/1979990000/canary.json — ETA 3m

sasha: FYI include a fallback: if kernel switch rate > 50 switches/min or p99 > 500ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows, auto-roll back. add alert to eng-runtime-oncall channel. :warning:

zhen: noted. I will run the canary now and post the first 10m metrics. thanks all. :thumbsup:
